import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static final int MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p_input = sc.nextInt();
        int k_input = sc.nextInt();

        if (k_input == 0) {
            long total = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i < p_input; ++i) {
                total = (total * p_input) % MOD_CONST;
            }
            System.out.println(total);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        int[] arr = new int[MAXN];
        boolean[] visited_flag = new boolean[MAXN];

        for (int i = 1; i < p_input; ++i) {
            arr[i] = (int)((long)k_input * i % p_input);
        }

        long result = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < p_input; ++i) {
            if (!visited_flag[i]) {
                int cycle_len = 0;
                int index = i;
                int product_tmp = 1;
                while (!visited_flag[index]) {
                    visited_flag[index] = true;
                    index = arr[index];
                    cycle_len++;
                    product_tmp = (int)((long)product_tmp * k_input % p_input);
                }
                if (cycle_len == 1) {
                    int multiplier = (k_input == 1) ? p_input : 1;
                    result = (result * multiplier) % MOD_CONST;
                } else {
                    assert product_tmp == 1;
                    result = (result * p_input) % MOD_CONST;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
